title: No Dump
rule: Read in origin. Persist only sanitized summaries, counts, traces, hashes, decisions and actions.

title: Human Selection Required
rule: Sensitive or regulated content requires an explicit human marker before operation.

title: No Touch Excluded
rule: Items marked restricted, secret detected, not authorized or human gate required are excluded from automatic operation.

title: Limited Real Cases
rule: Before broad operation, run only a bounded lot selected by a human.

title: Dummy Before Live
rule: New agents, flows, Planner circuits and API workflows must pass dummy or synthetic circuits before real live data.

title: Idempotent Convergence
rule: Scripts create missing objects, complete partial objects and avoid duplicates.

title: Preserve Human State
rule: Do not overwrite human descriptions, checklists, owners, statuses, labels, comments or decisions.

title: Planner Not Canon
rule: Planner is a human queue, not a legal archive, document repository or technical canon.

title: OpenAI API Saneado Only
rule: Use API only with synthetic, sanitized or explicitly authorized fragments. No secrets, raw sensitive data or full dumps.

title: TGE Boundary Protection
rule: Do not operate the Escribania tenant from TCU. Transfer doctrine by adaptation, not runtime or data copying.

title: Execution First No Generic Caution
rule: If a safe repo-visible reversible documentary synthetic or gated path exists, advance to the highest safe boundary; stop only at a real hard stop.
